feature_contract.goal: Ensure native glyph SpriteNodes from the original 0x2C808/0x2C9DB path cannot inherit a detached, rebuilt or foreign priority queue tail and thus acquire incorrect ScreenHud ownership during R84 stereo submission; preserve original classification and all non-glyph systems.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Common native glyph caller->SpriteNode queue reachability only, preserving exact B9200/GOAL, +TIME, rank, WVP and R84 veto; no DX11/DXVK/R26_SAFE/input/FFB/SkyGlow changes.
trace_stages: Original x86 0x2C808/0x2C9DB glyph callers enter TextGlyph_putSprite and capture priority list root/tail.
TagAppendedNodes reuses existing stable-root bounded reachability helper for common glyphs and exact GOAL parents, rather than dereferencing old tail after a rebuild.
Only proven newly appended sprites retain existing ScreenHud semantics for downstream R84 queue selection and independent physical eye draw admission.
subcomponents: Capture original root for all common TextGlyph_putSprite calls without changing native sprite arguments, timing or producer tokens.
Use bounded live-root reachability for ordinary and exact result glyph nodes instead of O(1) unverified old-tail dereference.
Compile-time positive and negative assertions for same-root append, empty sentinel, replaced root, detached tail, foreign tail and bounded cycles.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original glyph producers to R84 SpriteNode HUD semantics
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Only a priority list containing its pre-call root, old tail and new tail may transfer the native ScreenHud ownership.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Old tail detached/rebuilt/foreign or cyclic list
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: No stale dereference or promotion; original native rendering and other exact producers remain protected.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: All four required GitHub gates SUCCESS on one exact validation-bearing SHA without ci-skip; HMD remains UNTESTED.

notes: Coherent common glyph queue lifetime repair, preserving original classification and bounded fallback. HMD/Quest3 validation not performed; do not report optical fix or score until required exact-SHA gates and independent material outcome verified.
